text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While passing by the cafeteria,
a floral, herbal scent drifted my way.
choice_data_list: Is it coming from the kitchen...?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Just like that, El.
Let us prepare delicious dandelion dishes together.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, buenos dias!
See Grass, people really are surprised by this~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El came over after hearing you got a top-recommendation ingredient...
never imagining it would be dandelions!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, would you like a taste?
...You two over there, please join us as well♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hawawa... S-Sorry.
Rice smelled something wondrous and couldn't help it...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Pyah...! M-My apologies!
I caught the blessed aura of my faves and just—
Wait, join you...?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa...! Watching horse girl cuties
cooking together from this close...!
Is this a dream? Am I dreaming right now...?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The dandelion leaves and roots used in cooking
have a refreshing bitterness that becomes quite addictive~.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fueh... It's bitter... auu...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please do not worry. If you dislike bitterness,
I will blanch them to make them milder and sweeter.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I challenge myself to prepare Japanese dandelion cuisine daily.
I am sure there is a dish suited to everyone's palate~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If you have any requests, please let me know.
With dandelions, we can make ohitashi, tempura,
kinpira, clear soup, and—
choice_data_list: You can make that many dishes...?!
You can make that many dishes...?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I would love for everyone to enjoy a full dandelion course today.
...You see—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I ended up growing too many ornamental dandelions...
so I wished to share them with everyone.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! There are so many dandelion dishes!
El doesn't know which one to start with.
Well then, itadakimasu deeees!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—¡Esta riiico!
This kinpira's bitterness with a touch of spice!
Delicious! Exquisite! A whole new flavor deeees!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
This ohitashi is faintly sweet...!
Ehehe...♪ Thank you, Grass-san.
choice_data_list: To think dandelions could be this delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I am honored♪ Dandelions have such a deep history,
even being used in the wild herb cuisine popular during the Edo period.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Whether as an ingredient or a wild flower,
they exist close to people... If even a bit of that charm
comes across, I will be delighted.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Howaa...! To think Grass-san stans dandelions this much...!
choice_data_list: Was there something that made you fall in love with them?
Was there something that made you fall in love with them?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, who can say?
The reason I fell in love with them
is something I have already forgotten.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Mumu, that sounds pretty suspicious dees.
Is that really true...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reason Grass Wonder loves dandelions so deeply.
Indeed, would someone become this captivated just because they taste good?
choice_data_list: Maybe eating more dishes will make it clear.
Maybe learning more about dandelions will make it clear.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My... Wanting to eat even more?
I am deeply honored.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Then please, help yourself to this bento if you like.
I have prepared portions for everyone♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My! In that case, leave it to me.
Dandelions have a long-standing bond with Japan,
and a certain famous haiku poet once wrote verse of horse girls and dandelions—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Mgyaaa?! T-T-To hear my oshi speak from such an S-tier seat...!
Blessing upon blessing~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Desperately suppressing the urge to pump her fists in triumph, Agnes Digital listened intently to Grass Wonder's dandelion lecture.
